name: popover-morph
title: Popover Morph Popover
description: Composable MorphPopover, MorphPopoverTrigger, MorphPopoverContent; the panel is laid out full size but clipped to the corner nearest the trigger, then unclips as one piece — a single-surface morph with a drop-shadow that hugs the shape. Side/align aware, controlled or uncontrolled.
author: Saurabh <saurabh10102@gmail.com>
